_meta.note: REST GetFills Fill schema. Carries BOTH identity spellings (trade_id documented as 'legacy field name, same as fill_id') and BOTH ticker spellings (market_ticker documented as 'legacy field name, same as ticker') - the exact inverse of the WS user-fills message (fill.json), which has neither fill_id nor ticker. side is the deprecated legacy direction vocabulary; outcome_side/book_side are canonical.
